verses.text: وَم<tajweed class=madda_obligatory>َآ</tajweed> أَ<tajweed class=qalaqah>دْ</tajweed>رَ<tajweed class=madda_normal>ٮٰ</tajweed>كَ مَا <tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لْقَارِعَةُ

يَوْمَ يَكُونُ <tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed><tajweed class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</tajweed><tajweed class=ghunnah>نّ</tajweed>َاسُ كَ<tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لْفَرَاشِ <tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لْمَ<tajweed class=qalaqah>بْ</tajweed>ث<tajweed class=madda_permissible>ُو</tajweed>ثِ

وَتَكُونُ <tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لْجِبَالُ كَ<tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لْعِهْنِ <tajweed class=ham_wasl>ٱ</tajweed>لْمَ<tajweed class=ikhafa>نف</tajweed><tajweed class=madda_permissible>ُو</tajweed>شِ
فَأَ<tajweed class=ghunnah>مّ</tajweed>َا مَ<tajweed class=ikhafa>ن ث</tajweed>َقُلَتْ مَو<tajweed class=madda_normal>َٲ</tajweed>زِينُهُۥ
وَأَ<tajweed class=ghunnah>مّ</tajweed>َا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَو<tajweed class=madda_normal>َٲ</tajweed>زِينُهُۥ
وَم<tajweed class=madda_obligatory>َآ</tajweed> أَ<tajweed class=qalaqah>دْ</tajweed>رَ<tajweed class=madda_normal>ٮٰ</tajweed>كَ مَا هِيَهْ
